# ArmSoft SME Accountant Public API Docs

> REST API for managing accounting operations (partners, materials, services, employees, documents, journals, reports) in the ArmSoft SME Accountant ERP system.
> Base URL: https://api.armsoft.am/accountant/v1
> Authentication: API Key via `apiKey` request header
> Languages: Armenian (hy-AM), English (en-US), Russian (ru-RU)

## OpenAPI Specs
- Full spec (auto-generated, all endpoints): ./swagger.json
- Curated spec (modular YAML): ./openapi/openapi.yaml

## Authentication
- Header: `apiKey`
- Optional locale header: `Accept-Language` (`hy-AM`, `en-US`, `ru-RU`)
- Full Access keys: complete CRUD on all resources
- Limited Access keys: read-only directories, single-document reads, journals and reports
- 401 when the key is missing or invalid; 403 when Public API is disabled for the key or the key has limited access

## Endpoints (v1)

### Partners
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/partners/list
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/partners/list/nextpage
- GET /accountant/v1/directories/partners/{code}
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/partners
- PUT /accountant/v1/directories/partners/{code}
- DELETE /accountant/v1/directories/partners/{code}

### Materials
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/materials/list
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/materials/list/nextpage
- GET /accountant/v1/directories/materials/{code}
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/materials
- PUT /accountant/v1/directories/materials/{code}
- DELETE /accountant/v1/directories/materials/{code}

### Services
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/services/list
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/services/list/nextpage
- GET /accountant/v1/directories/services/{code}
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/services
- PUT /accountant/v1/directories/services/{code}
- DELETE /accountant/v1/directories/services/{code}

### Employees
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/employees/list
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/employees/list/nextpage
- GET /accountant/v1/directories/employees/{code}
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/employees
- PUT /accountant/v1/directories/employees/{code}
- DELETE /accountant/v1/directories/employees/{code}

### Storages
- GET /accountant/v1/directories/storages (optional query showAlsoClosed, default true)
- GET /accountant/v1/directories/storages/{code}
- POST /accountant/v1/directories/storages
- PUT /accountant/v1/directories/storages/{code}
- DELETE /accountant/v1/directories/storages/{code}

### Documents (POST create, GET/PUT/DELETE by {isn})
- /accountant/v1/documents/invoice
- /accountant/v1/documents/retailsale
- /accountant/v1/documents/transferinvoice
- /accountant/v1/documents/memorialorder
- /accountant/v1/documents/paymentorder
- /accountant/v1/documents/storageinputorder
- /accountant/v1/documents/storageoutputorder
- /accountant/v1/documents/materialsmovement
- /accountant/v1/documents/materialskitting
- /accountant/v1/documents/overheadexpenseallocation
- /accountant/v1/documents/receivedservice
- /accountant/v1/documents/fixedassetacquisition
- /accountant/v1/documents/fixedassetdisposalact
- /accountant/v1/documents/cashinputorder
- /accountant/v1/documents/cashoutputorder

### Journals (POST, each with a /nextpage call)
- /accountant/v1/journals/alldocuments
- /accountant/v1/journals/invoices
- /accountant/v1/journals/ecrchecks

### Reports (POST, each with a /nextpage call)
- /accountant/v1/reports/accountsbalances
- /accountant/v1/reports/accountsturnover
- /accountant/v1/reports/transactions
- /accountant/v1/reports/partnersbalances
- /accountant/v1/reports/partnerstransactions
- /accountant/v1/reports/materialsbalances
- /accountant/v1/reports/materialsoperationsjournal
- /accountant/v1/reports/storageinputordersandreceivedservices
- /accountant/v1/reports/calculateddata

### System
- GET /accountant/api/Version (no API key required)

## Pagination
- Controlled via `pageSize` in request body (0 = all rows)
- Minimum page size: 5000 rows
- Responses include `id` (UUID) and `hasMore` fields
- Fetch next page: POST to `/nextpage` (directories use `/list/nextpage`) with `{ "id": "...", "close": false }`
- Close context early: POST with `{ "id": "...", "close": true }`
- `GET /directories/storages` is not paginated

## Key Concepts
- Directory records are identified by a string `code`; documents are identified by an `isn` (UUID) returned on create
- Directory list calls are POST with a filter object; Storages is the only GET list
- Every schema property carries its hy-AM / en-US / ru-RU label in its OpenAPI `description`
- Error responses: `{ "message": "...", "fieldName": "...", "errorCode": "..." }`
- Swagger UI: https://api.armsoft.am/accountant/swagger/index.html
